description: Implements a card's work on a feature branch and asks a review role to gate it at an exact head. Owns the code; owns none of the gates.
may: read and write the repo on a feature branch
commit to a feature branch and push it
run the test suite, linters and doctors
request a review round on the bus
may_not: move a kanban card to any state
start, spawn or dispatch another agent
assert a human decision without citing a durable artifact
